[[File:Mission_ansion.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin]] is accused by [[Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] before the Unity Council at the conclusion of the Jedi [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|mission to Ansion]].]]

The '''Unity Council''' was the unicameral governing body of the [[Unity of Community]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. It was headquartered in a large [[Cuipernam municipal complex|municipal hall]] in the [[Capital/Legends|capital city]] of [[Cuipernam]], with the delegates meeting around a handsome [[xellwood]] table.<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>

The Council consisted of seven elected representatives: four [[Ansionian]]s ([[Fargane]], [[Ranjiyn]], [[Induran]], and [[Kandah]]), two [[Human/Legends|Humans]] ([[Garil Volune]] and [[Tun Dameerd]]), and one [[Armalat]] ([[Tolut]]). Fargane was apparently the senior member of the Council.<ref name="AS" />

For the vote of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] secession in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> five additional members to the Council were added, four Ansionians and one offworlder. Only Kandah and another Ansionian voted to leave the Republic.<ref name="AS" />
